subject: POC kickoff — calendar options, sample payloads, and hands-on agenda
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: POC kickoff — calendar options, sample payloads, and hands-on agenda

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for agreeing to the POC. To get the hands-on workshop productive we want to lock a 2-hour POC kickoff where we:
- review representative prompts and evaluation metrics
- walk through routing/variant config (latency vs cost)
- run an abbreviated load test with your sample payloads

Can you share two 2-hour windows next week (US ET preferred) that work for your team? Suggested slots: Tue 10–12 ET or Thu 14–16 ET, but open to alternatives.

A couple of asks up front so our engineers can prep:
- Upload an anonymized sample payload set (300–500 prompts ideally) — see redaction guidance below.
- Include an evaluation set (30–50 golden prompts + expected labels) if you have them.
- Indicate routing priority: latency-sensitive vs batch-preferable flows.

Redaction guidance (quick):
- Replace all PHI identifiers with stable tokens: [PATIENT_ID_#], [DOB], [MRN] etc.
- Strip free-text notes of explicit names/e-mail addresses; preserve structure of fields.
- If you cannot share PHI, please provide a synthetically generated set with same length distribution.

Attachments: I’ve attached a redaction_template.md and a sample_payloads_template.csv to make this straightforward. We also have an SFTP and a Google Drive folder — whichever is easiest.

Proposed agenda (2 hrs):
1) 15m intros + goals
2) 30m prompt & eval review
3) 45m hands-on routing + quick model comparison
4) 20m load test run (short duration)
5) 10m next steps / mutual action plan

If you prefer, we can split into two 1-hour sessions (prompt review then hands-on).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments referenced: redaction_template.md, sample_payloads_template.csv

Ben —

Thanks for the clear outline. We’re excited to move forward. A few constraints on our side:
- Key stakeholders (engineering + data privacy) are only available Thu afternoon PT this week and Tue/Wed next week.
- We’d like the hands-on load test to include peak-hour bursts; can you confirm safe limits for burst traffic?
- Regarding data upload: our security team prefers SFTP over Drive for anything containing PHI. Is that OK?

Proposed availability (all PT):
- Thu 23 Jul 14:00–16:00 PT
- Tue 28 Jul 10:00–12:00 PT

We’ll aim to upload a sanitized sample dataset by Monday EOD (we may need your redaction example to confirm). Joe (cc’d) will coordinate the engineering-side upload.

Thanks,
Amy Liu
Senior Product Manager — Data Platform
Acme Health
amy.liu@acmehealth.com | +1 206-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — calendar options, sample payloads, and hands-on agenda

Amy — perfect, thanks for the availability. SFTP is fine. Details below:

SFTP for uploads: sftp://upload.redwoodinference.com/acme-poc-inbox (user: acme_poc_team — we’ll DM temporary creds).
Drive (read-only for docs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-POC-data

Burst/load test guidance:
- Safe short burst: ~200 concurrent connections, 10k tokens/sec aggregate for a 5–10 minute test (we’ll coordinate throttling).
- We’ll always run load tests against a dedicated test cluster to avoid affecting other customers.

Requested sample payloads:
- 300–500 prompts that reflect real length distribution; include an eval set of 30–50 golden prompts with expected outputs/labels in a separate CSV.
- If you must keep PHI internal, provide a synthetic set with matching token lengths and a small mapping file describing replacements.

I’ve attached: redaction_template.md and sample_payloads_template.csv. Also attaching a short agenda doc for the workshop (agenda_poc_workshop.pdf).

Can you confirm Thu 23 Jul 14:00–16:00 PT works? If so I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — calendar options, sample payloads, and hands-on agenda

Quick tech notes from infra ahead of the session:
- For routing tests we’ll provision two model variants: a low-latency quantized model and a higher-accuracy float model. We’ll want sample prompts tagged by priority so we can simulate routing policy.
- For the load test, please indicate the split you want: e.g., 80% low-latency, 20% batch. If unknown, we’ll use anatomy: 60/40.
- Please include expected token-length histogram if possible (we can infer, but explicit bounds speed setup).

If Amy can provide the eval labels, we’ll run an automatic BLEU/ROUGE and an application-level pass/fail metric.

Rishi
Senior Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference

Amy
